ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.7.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - WorldNews
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Makes the RimWorld feel alive, reactive, and historically grounded by acting as the local journalist and gossip mill for the planet. Generates dynamic newspapers based on real events in your game.
--- Roadmap --- 0.8 - Demographics, News and Narrative Voice: The newspaper starts reporting the world map - a change feed of borders, outposts and ideology shifts, quest outcomes that become news factions react to, planetary news-feed and settlement-status tools, on-demand lore retrieval, and a dependency on Regions and Territories. 0.9 - Factions and Living Societies: Ideological artefacts abroad - the article, the conversion, and the war it might start. 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: Another pass over how the news draws on every module. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.7.0) - Regions and Territories Compatibility --- - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/WorldNews/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates newspapers tracking royal ascensions and empire news. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates theological debate columns and festival coverage. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates genetic breakthrough and mechanitor threat articles. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Generates creepy tabloid stories about void sightings. - RimSynapse - Factions: Compatible and Optional. WorldNews will dynamically report on the procedurally generated histories, schisms, and wars of your custom LLM factions. - RimSynapse - Psychology: Compatible and Optional. Newspapers will gossip about your colonists' psychological breakdowns and dramatic therapy sessions.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
